title: Grill TUI re-asks a vague expected outcome
body:
### Summary

As a human grilling a story on a terminal, I want the interview to ask again when my expected outcome is vague, so that I fix it before review.

### Completion Goal

1. [recording] state: the grill story TUI with the expected outcome "works well"; expected: the interview asks a follow-up before the next question
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu grill story` with a draft whose expected outcome is "works well"; expected: the draft is reported with a vague-outcome problem

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 2 criteria

### Scenario

Run the TUI with a scripted vague answer, then validate the same draft with flags.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

### Links

depends-on #41
